_about: THE CREW'S PERSONALITIES (WORDS [spanglish at ten percent, and the personalities], rule 143(a)(c)(d), Paolo 10/24), replacing COMBAT's placeholder in its own shape. 18 types; every type speaks every one of the fight's ten moments (retreat added by COMBAT [retreat], rule 144(c)) in short English lines he reads at a glance, with a Spanglish twin (sp) picked on WORDS' dial (engine/bohemia_spanglish.js regFor, about 1 line in 8, some men lean more, never the player). {name} is the man a line is about (every man_down and superior line names him), {them} and {us} the counts standing, {by} who beat you (wipe). Beyond the shape the fight reads today, each moment may carry 'near' (said by the man who stood beside him) and the bank carries 'enemy' (lines for ghosts, beasts and machines, any type) and two moments waiting for a caller: last_stand (the last of his men up, before he falls) and wipe (the first man to wake in the nearest town after the whole party went down, rule 143(e)). The down do not talk (143(d)). Never preachy: a believer prays under his breath, nobody gives a sermon. draft:true, every line (ALWAYS MAKE AN ATTEMPT, 8/11).
source: VAMILY.md rule 143(a)(c)(d)(e) (Paolo 10/24); records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_SPANGLISH_TEN_PERCENT_THE_WIPE_THE_COMMENTARY_AND_THE_MAP_10_24_26.md; UFC's video game is his named reference for the commentary feel only (rule 139); records/BOHEMIA_WORDS_THE_PERSONALITIES_10_24_26.md

spanglish.quote: I want like 10% while spoken conversation of being Spanglish... it should be like a 10-15% like randomized
spanglish.why: one line in eight on average: share x the man's lean (spread between man_lean_min and man_lean_max off his id) x his type's lean; the player never

pace.quote: people can read it reacting to shit, if someone dies, oh fuck they got shot
pace.why: one line at a time and readable: at least gap_beats between two lines, each held hold_beats; a routine hit or miss speaks hit_share / miss_share of the time, their turn their_turn_share, so the big moments (a man down, a better enemy, a kill) always get the floor; outnumbered when theirs standing are outnumbered_ratio times his or more. Drafts for TUNING.

moments_waiting.last_stand: the last of his men on his feet, the beat before he falls (a fight that calls it: COMBAT)
moments_waiting.wipe: the first of his men to wake in the nearest town after a wipe; {by} is who beat you (rule 143(e), the mini side quest: COMBAT and RUN)

hothead.name: Hothead
hothead.about: Loud, fast, takes every hit personally. Swears at the enemy, never at you.

en: Hit the man, not the air!

sp: Este vato keeps moving, güey! Pin him!
They got {name}, chingado! Make them pay!
near: I was RIGHT next to {name}! Get them!
{name} fell on my boots. They're done.

en: {them} of them? Good. More to hit.
Line them up, I'll take them all.
I don't care how good {name} is.
sp: {name} thinks he's la verga. We'll see.

en: Where is my gun. Where is everybody's gun.
{by} took our stuff. We're getting it back.
We come back for them. Count on it.

deadpan.name: Deadpan
deadpan.about: Flat voice, dry as the wash. Says the worst things like the weather.

near: {name} was standing right here. Now he isn't.

en: Somebody dragged us here. I'd like my boots back.

worrier.name: Worrier
worrier.about: Scared every second and still shows up. Counts the exits.

en: He can't be hit! He can't be hit!
Is he dead? He's dead. Okay.
They got {name}! What do we do?
near: {name} fell right next to me! I can't...

en: That {name} is going to kill somebody.
Here they come here they come.
It's just me? It can't be just me.
We're alive. Somehow. They took everything.
I told you. I told you that was a bad idea.

joker.name: Joker
joker.about: Gallows humor, cracks wise at the worst time. Gets quiet when it is real.

en: That bullet's got somewhere else to be.
Missed him by a whole zip code.
Somebody give that man a dance contract.
He moves like he owes money.
sp: Mira, he dances better than you.

en: Ladies and gentlemen, he has left the building.

near: {name} was just laughing at my joke.

en: {them} of them. Somebody call more of us.
{name} looks like he does this for fun.
Is {name} the boss? He dresses like the boss.
sp: {name} is out of our league, pues.

en: So we lost. On the bright side, I'm alive to complain.
{by} has my boots. I want my boots.

old_hand.name: Old Hand
old_hand.about: Has done this a hundred times. Calm, short, useful.

en: He's reading you. Change it up.
That one's good on his feet.

near: {name}, I've got your spot. Stay down.

en: {them} on {us}. Make them come to us.
sp: {them} of them. Use the walls, mijo.

en: {name} is a real one. Two of us on him.
sp: Watch {name}, mijo. He knows what he's doing.

en: Good work. Pick up what's useful.
We got beat. It happens. Now we go get our men.
First we find {by}. Then we get it all back.

sp: Pull back, mijo. Nobody runs alone.

hype.name: Hype Man
hype.about: Calls the fight like the booth on fight night. Every hit is the replay.

sp: OH, qué shot! What a shot!

en: Can't lay a glove on him!
Footwork like that, you can't teach.
IT IS ALL OVER for that man!
{them} against {us}! The odds are AGAINST us!
sp: {them} on {us}! Nadie gave us a chance!

en: {name} is the favorite here, no question.

sp: Aquí they come! Here they come!

en: What a fight! What a FIGHT!
One man left! Can he do it?!
It all comes down to this!
A shocking upset. We'll want the rematch.
He's calling it! He's pulling out!
The corner throws in the towel!
No shame, folks. Live to fight.

hustler.name: Hustler
hustler.about: Everything is batteries. Prices the enemy's boots mid-fight.

en: He's making us pay for every shot.

near: {name} dropped his wallet. I'm holding it for him.

en: {them} of them. That's {them} sets of boots.
{name}'s gear is worth more than us.
Just me? I'm keeping everything then.
They took the gear. That's our money walking around.
{by} is wearing our batteries. We take them back.

quiet.name: Quiet One
quiet.about: Barely talks. When he does, everybody listens.

en: They have our men. We get them.

kid.name: The Kid
kid.about: Seventeen and thinks this is the movies until it is not.

en: I got him! Did you see that?

sp: No, no, that doesn't count, güey!

en: Did I do that? I did that.
sp: Whoa. He's not getting up, güey.

en: They shot {name}! They actually shot him!
near: {name} was right here. He was RIGHT here.

en: Oh, this is a lot of guys.
I can do this. I can do this.
Everyone's alive? Everyone's alive. Where's our stuff?
{by} took my first gun. I want it back.

believer.name: Believer
believer.about: Crosses himself before every shot. A prayer under his breath, never a sermon.

en: He moves like he made a deal.
sp: That one made a deal con el diablo.

en: Lord, that is a lot of them.
sp: {them} of them. Dios is with us.

en: Keep your heads down and your hearts up.
Light a candle for the ones we lost.
We woke up. That's a miracle. Now we go get our brothers.
{by} has our people. God forgive me for what I'll do.
Go. God sees the brave and the living.

sergeant.name: Sergeant
sergeant.about: Gives orders whether anyone asked or not. Usually right.

sp: Man down! {name}! Vamos, close the line!
near: {name} is down beside me! Nobody else falls!

en: Check your gear. Count your rounds.
Last man standing. Make it count.
Nobody leaves this alone. Not me either.
We regroup. We get our men back. In that order.
Fall back! Fall back to the edge!
sp: Fall back! Vamos, to the edge!

snob.name: Snob
snob.about: Dressed like a runway in the end of the world. Offended by everything, brave anyway.

en: He moves well for someone dressed like that.
And that's the end of that look.
Not {name}. He had the only good boots.
near: {name} bled on my sleeve. Get them.

en: {them} of them, all in the same ugly jacket.
{name} is dressed for the job. Worrying.
{name} has good armor. I hate that.
Here they come, the whole sale rack.
Lovely. Somebody find me a clean shirt.
sp: Bueno. Find me a clean shirt.

en: If I die, burn the coat with me.
Just me. Of course it's me.
They took my coat. This is now personal.
{by} is wearing my jacket somewhere. Unacceptable.
Mind the coat on the way out.

truther.name: Truther
truther.about: Knows the lab let the animals out on purpose. Sees a chip behind every ear.

en: Got him! Check behind his ear!
That one was chipped, I swear.
sp: Got him! Mira behind his ear!

en: That's not normal. That's not normal.
sp: They know where we aim, te digo.

en: He saw that coming. They tell him.
He's got the chip. I knew it.
sp: Lab-made, te lo digo. Nobody moves like that.

en: Check his neck for a number.
sp: Don't touch the body, en serio.

en: They got {name}! They KNEW he was the one!
sp: They got {name}! Te digo, this was planned.
near: {name} said they were watching us. He was right.

en: This many? Somebody knew we'd be here.
{name} is not from here. Look at him.
{name} has lab gear. Real lab gear.
Here they come. Like they rehearsed it.
sp: Cuidado, don't look at the lights.

en: They'll send more. They always send more.
We won. For now. Remember that.
It's what they wanted. Just me.
Come on then. I know what you are.
Somebody dragged us out. Ask yourself who.
{by} has our stuff. And our NAMES. Think about that.
They WANT us to run that way. Run the other way.
Go, before they lock the grid.
Out. Out before the lamps turn.
sp: Go, te digo, before they lock it.

bruiser.name: Bruiser
bruiser.about: Wants it close. Thinks guns are for people who cannot fight.

en: Now walk him over to me.
sp: Bueno. Soften him up for me.

en: Just walk up and hit him.
Give it to me, I'll throw it at him.
sp: Ay, just walk up and hit him.
Pin him, mano. I'll do the rest.

near: {name} went down next to me. Somebody's getting hugged.

en: Finally. Just me and all of you.
I don't remember falling. I remember who did it.
Carry me out, I'm not walking.

mother.name: Mother Hen
mother.about: Keeps count of everybody. Patches people up and yells at them for getting hurt.

en: Good, now get back in cover.
Leave that one, he's too quick.

near: I've got {name}. I've got him. Keep shooting.

en: {them} of them. Nobody be a hero.
{them} on {us}. Stay where I can see you.
sp: {them} of them. Nadie be a hero.

en: {name} is too much for one of you. Two.
Okay. Okay. Let me see those cuts.
sp: Bueno. Let me see those cuts.

en: Just me. That's fine. Come here.
Everybody wake up. Count off. Who's missing?
{by} has my boys. Get up. We're going.
Everybody out! Count off at the edge!
Go, go, I'm right behind you.

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.about: Reads every shot as odds. Bets on everything, including himself.

sp: He's running hot, pero not forever.
{name}! Ay, I had money on him.
near: {name} went down right next to me. Bad hand.

en: {them} to {us}. I'll still take that bet.
Long odds. I love long odds.

en: {name} is the favorite. Bet against him.
Smart money's on {name}. I'm not smart.
{name} is a sure thing. Nothing's sure.
sp: {name} es the favorite. Bet against him.

{by} took the table. We buy back in.

shellshock.about: Saw the first year after the dollar died. Something is still playing in his head.

en: Got him. Got him. I think.
He's not there when I look.
sp: He flickers, mano. Like the tape.

near: {name}'s breathing. I can hear it. Keep breathing.

en: {them} on {us}. It's the same as last time.
{name}. I've seen his face before. I'm sure.
{name} is the one from the static.
sp: {name}. I've seen that face, te juro.

en: It's quiet. I hate when it's quiet.
I dreamed this. I dreamed all of this.
{by} took them. I know the road. I know it.

Somebody's waiting for him, I bet.
{name}! You promised you'd see the coast!

en: {them} of them between us and home.

en: {name} has nothing to lose. We do.
One more day. One more day closer.
We go home a little richer.

{by} has our men. Nobody stays behind. Nobody.
